lines.text: It was the night of the boat festival in Mali's village by the river.
say: It was the night of the boat festival in Mali's village by the river.

lines.text: Everyone put a little leaf boat with a candle on the water.
say: Everyone put a little leaf boat with a candle on the water.

lines.text: Mali walked down to the water with her red kite. It was her favourite thing in the world.
say: Mali walked down to the water with her red kite. It was her favourite thing in the world.

lines.text: Then the wind came. Whoosh! Snap! The kite string broke.
say: Then the wind came. Whoosh! Snap! The kite string broke.

lines.text: "My kite!" cried Mali. She ran after it, but it flew far away over the dark river.
say: cried Mali. She ran after it, but it flew far away over the dark river.

lines.text: Mali stood at the edge of the river. The moon was big and bright.
say: Mali stood at the edge of the river. The moon was big and bright.

lines.text: Then, one by one, round stones of moonlight came up out of the water.
say: Then, one by one, round stones of moonlight came up out of the water.

lines.text: It was a bridge! A moon bridge, all the way across the river.
say: It was a bridge! A moon bridge, all the way across the river.

lines.text: Far away, the red kite danced in the air. "Wait for me!" said Mali.
say: Far away, the red kite danced in the air.

lines.text: Hop, hop, hop! Mali jumped from stone to stone, all the way across.
say: Hop, hop, hop! Mali jumped from stone to stone, all the way across.

lines.text: The kite came down on a high roof. Mali walked closer and gasped.
say: The kite came down on a high roof. Mali walked closer and gasped.

lines.text: It was a market on boats! Shy little spirits sold flowers, fruit and paper lanterns.
say: It was a market on boats! Shy little spirits sold flowers, fruit and paper lanterns.

lines.text: But five lanterns were dark, and the spirits looked sad.
say: But five lanterns were dark, and the spirits looked sad.

lines.text: Behind a basket, something tiny was hiding. Mali crouched down to look. It was Pip, a little lantern-moth.
say: Behind a basket, something tiny was hiding. Mali crouched down to look. It was Pip, a little lantern-moth.

lines.text: "I don't like the dark," Pip whispered. "Can you help us?"
Mali left her kite on the roof and lit the lanterns, one by one. Pip glowed brighter and brighter!
say: Mali left her kite on the roof and lit the lanterns, one by one. Pip glowed brighter and brighter!

lines.text: Pip flew up and sat on Mali's shoulder. "Thank you! Now come and meet Tong."
say: Pip flew up and sat on Mali's shoulder.
Thank you! Now come and meet Tong.

lines.text: Mali followed Pip to a little leaf spirit called Tong. He was crying.
say: Mali followed Pip to a little leaf spirit called Tong. He was crying.

lines.text: "I lost my shadow," said Tong. "Everybody has a shadow, but not me!"
say: Everybody has a shadow, but not me!

lines.text: Mali picked up a lamp. "A shadow needs light," she said. "Let's find it."
She moved the lamp, and there it was! Tong and his shadow danced together.
say: She moved the lamp, and there it was! Tong and his shadow danced together.

lines.text: Grandma Nok sat in her boat. She was an old boat-singer. Mali sat down next to her.
say: Grandma Nok sat in her boat. She was an old boat-singer. Mali sat down next to her.

lines.text: "I lost my song," said Grandma Nok sadly. "My song shows the boats the way home."
say: My song shows the boats the way home.

lines.text: Mali listened. The lotus flowers rang softly: ding, dong, ding.
say: Mali listened. The lotus flowers rang softly: ding, dong, ding.

lines.text: "I know this song!" said Mali. She jumped up. "My grandma sings it at bedtime."
say: My grandma sings it at bedtime.

lines.text: Mali played the song on the lotus bells, note by note. Then Grandma Nok began to sing again.
say: Mali played the song on the lotus bells, note by note. Then Grandma Nok began to sing again.

lines.text: All the spirits lit their lanterns, and the river shone like gold.
say: All the spirits lit their lanterns, and the river shone like gold.

lines.text: Then Pip flew in with the red kite! Mali held it tight.
say: Then Pip flew in with the red kite! Mali held it tight.

lines.text: "Thank you, Mali," said Tong. "Now we will take you home."
say: Now we will take you home.

lines.text: Grandma Nok sang, and the lanterns rose up into the sky to show the way.
say: Grandma Nok sang, and the lanterns rose up into the sky to show the way.

lines.text: Her song carried the boat gently home. Mali waved goodbye at her door, and Pip glowed goodnight.
say: Her song carried the boat gently home. Mali waved goodbye at her door, and Pip glowed goodnight.

moral.text: When you share your light with others, it helps you find your way home.
say: When you share your light with others, it helps you find your way home.

game.text: Tap the dark boats to light their candles!
say: Tap the dark boats to light their candles!

game.text: Tap the glowing stone. Help Mali hop!
say: Tap the glowing stone. Help Mali hop!

game.text: Tap the dark lanterns to light them!
say: Tap the dark lanterns to light them!

game.text: Where should Mali put the lamp? Tap a spot!
say: Where should Mali put the lamp? Tap a spot!

game.text: Listen to the bells. Then tap them the same way!
say: Listen to the bells. Then tap them the same way!

game.text: Tap the lanterns to wake them up!
say: Tap the lanterns to wake them up!
